messages:
sara_cs: FYI — Orbit QBR tomorrow 11am PT. We have a 12-slide limit. Need owners for: 1) onboarding health, 2) renewal risks, 3) exec asks, 4) demo fallback. Can people claim slides now?

mike_csm: I can take onboarding health + one slide for enablement metrics. Will add bullet points later.

priya_ops: I'll take renewal risks + mitigation table. Will need help getting the latest usage numbers (weeknights spike). @eli_pdm can you provide? :eyes:

eli_pdm: on it — will paste the recent churn/signal numbers in a sec. Also recommend we surface the two lower-tier customers with noisy usage as examples.

jordan_eng: quick Q on demo fallback — do we want a live demo or recorded clip? live might be risky given rate limits.

sara_cs: agree with jordan — recorded clip + failover screenshot. Add a single bullet for fallback policy.

mike_csm: tagging slide ownership in the deck now: https://drive.fake/redwood/qbr-orbit-draft (v2). I'll leave comments for data points.

priya_ops: Action items I tracked: - Priya: renewal risks slide + mitigation (due EOD today) - Mike: onboarding health slide + enablement metrics (due EOD) - Eli: usage + churn numbers (by 6pm) - Jordan: demo clip + fallback screenshot (by 9pm) - Sara: exec asks + slide intro (by 9pm)

eli_pdm: pasted numbers: peak concurrent users +12% MoM, 7d DAU stable, 3 accounts show slow onboarding progression (weeks 1-2). Also exporting the CSV at /s3/orbit/qbr/metrics.csv

jordan_eng: uploaded 30s clip to the deck and added fallback screenshot. Note: demo uses a smaller model variant to reduce latency. Added caption: "fallback to compact model if latency > 400ms"

sara_cs: For exec asks — two asks: 1) commit to a dedicated training session for top 5 accounts, 2) a short-term discount for customers showing onboarding stall. Keep the asks strict and measurable.

mike_csm: Thumbs on the discount ask — can we make it a 3-month trial extension tied to activation metric?

priya_ops: I'll include proposed metric (activation = 3 successful API calls in 7 days) and owner for follow-through.

deploy-bot: Reminder: presentation deck auto-export scheduled at 02:00 UTC; manual export override available.

sara_cs: Final: I'll run a 20-min dry run at 10:15am tomorrow. Please be online for last-minute sync. Anything blocking?

mike_csm: all set here.

eli_pdm: sending final CSV to Priya now.

priya_ops: got it — will finish mitigation table and upload final deck before 9pm.

sara_cs: thanks team — will assemble the exec one-pager after deck freeze and ping leadership. :thumbsup:
